data.why: The pinned commit has no app.py (the repo was migrated to a FastAPI-only backend, see MIGRATED.md) and requirements.txt lacks streamlit, so seed/app.py reconstructs the Streamlit UI from the repo's own src/annual and src/common modules; the shipped data/sample CSVs only cover one year (2024) with a single province-wide 'city' row and malformed multi-row Excel headers, so seed/data/input supplies clean, properly-named per-county CSVs across three years (2019/2022/2024), two cities (杭州市, 衢州市) and three report tables so the city/year/category filters in the README actually have something to filter, including a missing value and a likely data-entry outlier (龙游县 2024 用水量 总用水量 = 8.70) for the researcher to catch.

goals: Browse multi-year (2019-2024) water-resource annual report data for Zhejiang Province
Filter records by prefecture-level city to compare water use across regions
Filter by report category (用水量 water-use, 供水量 water-supply, 社会经济指标 socio-economic indicators)
Spot data-quality problems such as an implausible total or a missing indicator value in a filtered result
Export the filtered query result as Excel or CSV for further offline analysis

review.summary: The tree describes this simple query-and-export tool accurately in three sensible phases, and every screen I sampled supports its node. It needs fixes before filing: it doesn't disclose that the UI is a reconstruction running on synthetic seed data, it misreports seed-data limits as limits of the tool, and it leaves out the multi-year comparison the README leads with.
